title: Plaid network
description: A pale two-column section: on the left a zig-zag column of white app notifications (coloured icon tile, app name, time, one-line message) alternating with small picture chips under long soft shadows; on the right a 70px navy heading, a 24px grey paragraph and a 2×2 grid of big light serif figures in a purple gradient that count up as they come into view, each over a 30px tight navy label. On phones the text and stacked figures come first, then rows of a notification beside a chip peeking in from the edge.
notes: media slots: the picture chips (238×83, 13px corners); the original's moving wave-line canvas behind the feed is left out
figures use var(--typeface-serif, Georgia); the count runs after hydration (static HTML shows the final numbers)
name: plaid-network

props.name: notes
props.description: the notifications in the feed (three or four)

props.name: chips
props.description: pictures for the chips between notifications; one more chip than notes is drawn, placeholders where missing
